global: Bandits on the north road again. Someone should post patrol times before the new folks walk into them.
Grain prices in {town} doubled overnight. Either the harvest failed or somebody is hoarding. I'd like to know which.
{rival} has been undercutting every market for a week. Clever, but cheap wins never last.
I don't mind losing a fight. I mind losing it to a rule nobody bothered to explain.
Balance patch again and half the veterans are grumbling. Give it a month before anyone panics, as usual.
Back in the first war we had bandits too, only they had no horses. Tougher times, I suppose.
The {faction} toll on the trade road is steep. Not the end of the world, but I'd like the reasoning.
Honestly, the siege timers are what I'd fix first. Crew up, sit at the gate, and wait an hour. Dull.
Hauling a cart across the fens for half its old value. Ser, I've paid worse for less, but not much worse.
Nobody asked me, but caravan guards should not be easier to bribe than the bandits are to hire. Just saying.
